newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 24.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories:
WASHINGTON - The Teamsters union may try to step up its pressure on Giant Food Inc. by expanding the walkout to firms hired to supply the supermarket chain during the strike.

WASHINGTON - The computer industry is coming up with unconventional keyboard designs intended to reduce strain on the hands and wrists, part of its answer to the complaints highlighted when a New York Jury awarded a secretary $5.3 million in a suit against Digital Equipment Corp.
WASHINGTON - The Treasury Department said it will delay the first auction of its inflation-indexed 10-year notes which had been scheduled for mid-January.

WASHINGTON - Mattel Inc. agreed to the Federal Trade Commission's $146,186 penalty for not delivering collectible Barbie dolls on time and not notifying customers of the delay or their right to refunds.
